# Sourpuss

> Find and rate the best whisky sours in your city.

Sourpuss is a mobile app for cocktail enthusiasts to discover, review, and rate whisky sours at bars. The app features ratings, photos, leaderboards, and a community of discerning sippers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sourpuss.app/): Main landing page with app features and download link
- [Privacy Policy](https://sourpuss.app/privacy): How we collect, use, and protect user data
- [Support](https://sourpuss.app/support): FAQs and contact information

## Key Features

- Find nearby bars with whisky sour ratings
- Rate and review whisky sours (1-5 scale)
- Upload photos of drinks
- View leaderboards for top bars and reviewers
- Save favorite bars

## Contact

- Email: support@sourpuss.app
- Website: https://sourpuss.app

## App Availability

Coming soon to the App Store.

## Technical

This is a static marketing website. The actual app is built with React Native (Expo) and uses Convex for the backend.
